RECOVERED_TOKENS, COMMIT_CALLS in store.rs) plus a shared on-disk recovery cache resolved
from the working root. Tests sharing a cache path or racing on the registry would explain
order dependence. Worth confirming before fixing.

Impact: any agent or CI gate that reads this suite's pass/fail gets a nondeterministic
answer, and real regressions can hide inside the noise band.

AC: repeated parallel runs of an unchanged tree report an identical failure set, and the

"did I break something", which is the one question it exists to answer. Proving commit
9fb8b57 was clean required serial before/after set-diffs instead.

Not fixed here -- handed off at user request. Bead returned to open.
